candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release

blender.skin: One skin for the monster and the pilot; rigid toy parts plus smoothstep blends along the spine (hips/spine_1/2/3), the legs, the tiny arms, the tail chain, the pilot coat, sleeves and antenna, and the straps (cockpit to torso)
blender.root: Identity, fixed floor-centred root; no root animation; the hips translate for the waddle, stomp, rear-back and the seated defeat
blender.bind_pose: The approved sheet pose (head tilt, mismatched pupils, the pilot raising the remote and pointing); the controls at rest reproduce it (max matrix error 2.2e-06)
blender.guards: Legs are two-bone IK with world ankle targets and an analytic foot floor guard; a tail floor guard pitches the tail root up just enough that the floor-resting tail never sinks (max pitch per clip in construction.json floor_guards). Soles and the tail contact are clamped to a 6 mm contact plane so keyframe interpolation stays above the floor.

materials.1: alpha BLEND bubble glass on the same atlas (single-sided; three.js GLTFLoader sets depthWrite false so the pilot shows through)

export.compression: None; no Draco, Meshopt or KTX2 requirement

preview.source: Exact delivered GLB via Three.js GLTFLoader
preview.renderer: Chromium headless ANGLE SwiftShader, real WebGL raster; no physical device claim
preview.gameplay_camera: Perspective 48 deg, 7.9 m out and 2.62 m high at azimuths 0/45/90/180/-90 deg, looking at 1.75 m (the game follow camera trails the player; the boss usually faces the player)
preview.lighting: Warm hemisphere plus three directional lights; ACES tone mapping exposure 1.0
